name: Nagaoka Rito
source:
A therapist at Aayus Lakshmi, a relaxation salon (Thai traditional massage store). She has a forceful and dynamic personality but when it comes to treatment, her skills as a masseur are first-class. Due to her excellent communication skills, she has the highest appointment rate in the world. She takes the liberty of putting herself in charge of Takashi and sexually harasses him while giving him treatments, but in fact she is planning to ensnare him and make him hers.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1139363]Getchu[/url]]
